newsitem.title: JAPAN: NAMCO to take over movie maker Nikkatsu.
newsitem.headline: NAMCO to take over movie maker Nikkatsu.

text.p: Game equipment maker NAMCO Ltd said on Friday it would take over financially troubled movie maker Nikkatsu Corp.
NAMCO will provide three billion yen on December 31 in cash as Nikkatsu's new capital.
The total liabilities of the movie maker and its affiliated firms are estimated at around 63 billion yen, NAMCO president Masaya Nakamura told a news conference.
As part of the restructuring plan, Nikkatsu will absorb six affiliated firms, Nakamura said.

He also said the restructuring programme would not affect NAMCO's consolidated performance for the 1996/97 business year, as its liabilities would not be confirmed until all legal transactions in its rehabilitation were completed.
In July 1993, Nikkatsu filed for protection from creditors under the Corporate Reorganisation and Rehabilitation Act.
Nakamura said in 1993 that his company was planning to use Nikkatsu's movie-making technology for the development of its multimedia software.
